affected_region.isometric: Cluster at x≈12m shows minimal vertical structure and is sparsely populated with points inconsistent with a physical vehicle.

evidence: The bounding box at (12m, 0.5m) encloses a very sparse, point-cluster lacking the typical structural density or L-shape of a vehicle.

alternatives_ruled_out: Low-reflectivity surface (the lack of any point cluster or vertical depth rules this out).
